run_failfast_tests: run the googletest fail_fast unit tests to verify test execution stops after first failure
test_fail_fast_flag: test the gtest_fail_fast command line flag to stop test execution on first failure
test_fail_fast_env_var: test the GTEST_FAIL_FAST environment variable to control fail fast behavior in googletest
test_bazel_fail_fast: test the TESTBRIDGE_TEST_RUNNER_FAIL_FAST bazel environment variable for fail fast configuration
test_fail_fast_xml_output: test the fail_fast behavior and verify XML output contains correct skipped and failed test counts
